items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: tryin' to play some of the more modern things that he heard in New York like Benny Golson, all that type, see.

ctx.x: Uh huh, but not you 'cause you weren't with -

I don't know if they fired him or Jacques left, I think it was some kind of trouble. Anyway Jacques left the place, I'll make it that way. He left the place, then he got another band - kinda bebop band, little Martinique saxophone player, tried to copy Charlie Parker and so forth. Then Al Levy [Levitt?] the trombone player went in there and he was tryin' to play some of the more modern things that he heard in New York like Benny Golson, all that type, see. And then they wasn't used to that, he was, they were used…
Was it an all-jazz gig or were you playing for acts at La Cigalle too?
